kpis.description_fr: Base tarifaire consolidée WEC Energy. Croissance soutenue ~9%/an via investment réseaux + génération + LNG (Plan 2025-29 28 Mds $).
kpis.description_en: WEC Energy consolidated rate base. ~9%/yr sustained growth via grid + generation + LNG investment (2025-29 $28B plan).

kpis.description_fr: Plan CapEx 5 ans 2025-29. 35% renewables, 25% T&D, 20% natural gas, 20% LNG/infrastructure. Drive EPS growth 6.5-7%.
kpis.description_en: 5-year CapEx plan 2025-29. 35% renewables, 25% T&D, 20% natural gas, 20% LNG/infrastructure. Drives 6.5-7% EPS growth.

kpis.description_fr: Total clients gas + electric (Wisconsin, Illinois, Michigan, Minnesota). Croissance lente, stable. Solid Midwest jurisdictions.
kpis.description_en: Total gas + electric customers (WI, IL, MI, MN). Slow stable growth. Solid Midwest jurisdictions.

kpis.description_fr: Capacité renouvelable contracté (solaire + battery + wind) sous développement. Plan COP exit + transition.
kpis.description_en: Contracted renewable capacity (solar + battery + wind) in development. Coal phase-out + transition plan.

kpis.description_fr: ROE autorisé moyen pondéré par État. Stable, juste autour de la moyenne US utility. Drive ROE actuel régulier.
kpis.description_en: Weighted-avg authorized ROE by state. Stable, around US utility average. Drives steady realized ROE.
